summary: Iteration 17 retest of the three fixes iteration 16 reported plus lighter regression on disp-1.4.0. All three fixes confirmed on the deployed preview. (1) EssentialResult single_dating framing now reads 'something to watch for rather than something to explain'; 'prediction, not a post-mortem' is absent from every result page. Checked all four instrument result pages on sample.reader (essential, personality, eq, closeness) and none carry any of the banned phrases. (2) PersonalityResult chance-level neutral note renders under data-testid=personality-validity-null-note at agree_count=4 with the exact copy 'you agreed with 4 of the ten most flattering statements, where about four is what content-blind answering produces on its own', and the best-self warning banner (data-testid=personality-validity-note) does NOT appear at count=4 — code review at line 53 confirms sd is derived as ELEVATED at 7 and HIGH at 9, and line 71 gates the banner behind sd!=='NORMAL', so it will appear at any stored count>=7. (3) /learn and all six essays (the-delta, the-interference, the-signal-box, why-you-keep-choosing-the-same-type, dont-waste-the-breakup, the-assessment-that-knows-its-place) load and render; 'week six' is absent everywhere; the surviving 'post-mortem' word on dont-waste-the-breakup is the approved editorial usage ('The post-mortem nobody performs') and is not one of the banned FORECAST_PHRASES. (4) tests/test_copy_lint.py::test_no_dated_forecasts_in_frontend_copy passes and is confirmed to fail when 'week six' is injected into situationFraming.js (asserted with a temporary injection then reverted — the guard flagged the offender on line 8 as expected). (5) EI_DOMAIN_MRD constant chain now agrees: services/reportable.py inline comment reads 0.765; the EI result page quotes 0.77 (rounded to 2 dp); /methodology quotes 0.77; docs/REPORTABLE_FLOORS.md reads 0.765. No stale 0.76 anywhere. (6) Lighter regression: combined PDF renders on sample.reader (200 · %PDF- signature · 34,175 bytes); all five individual instrument PDFs render (essential 8.9KB, personality 9.9KB, eq 7.1KB, everyday 9.5KB, closeness 6.3KB); ownership enforcement holds — ui.demo receives 403 on all five sample.reader session ids via /api/v2/assessments/{id}/result. Cross-check accounts (set1e/set2e/set3e) all authenticate OK; the emission-path assertions themselves remain covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16.py which is still 23/23 passing this pass. Full local pytest suite: 213 passed with RK_ALLOW_PLACEHOLDER_ALPHA=1 (backend/tests/test_iteration16.py + /app/tests/*).
critical_code_review_comments: PersonalityResult.js line 53 correctly re-derives sd from the frozen agree_count at read time using the new 9/7 cuts. The stored snapshot is never edited (write-once), and the two notes are correctly split: the neutral null-note runs only when sd==='NORMAL' && sdCount!=null (so it does not show if the account never took the SD items), and the warning banner runs only when sd && sd!=='NORMAL'. Both branches are mutually exclusive, so there is no double-render risk at the boundary.

tests/test_copy_lint.py::test_no_dated_forecasts_in_frontend_copy is a good sweep — scoped to frontend/src/{content,pages}/**.js and searches four exact substrings. Confirmed by injection that it catches offenders. One incidental note: it does not scan .jsx, so if authoring conventions ever switch, extend FRONTEND_COPY_DIRS handling to *.jsx as a defensive measure.
services/reportable.py EI_DOMAIN_MRD comment now reads 0.765 (matches mrd(0.60,0.70) rounded to 3 dp). The rendered 0.77 on the EI page/methodology is the same number to 2 dp — chain is consistent.
